name: BACH_0383
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (96%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
High benign probability [F1] is tempered by flagged image reliability (45%, 92nd OOD percentile) [F6] and cross-model disagreement.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 96%, InSitu 3%, Normal 1%, Invasive 0% | Strongly favors benign category |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 10% alpha (90% dataset coverage) | Single class at guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 45% reliability (flagged); 92nd OOD percentile | Atypical image; reduced confidence |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False (top classes differ) | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Benign (78%–90% similarity) [F5] | Nearest neighbors all Benign |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.91 SD, contrib -0.54) [F2] · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 6, 7, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (+0.92 SD, contrib -0.42) [F3] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 6, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical text score (+0.73 SD, contrib -0.33); caption inconsistent [F4] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.97 SD, contrib -0.31); 0/20 AI spot-check · Unreliable
- **Immune cell fraction** (regions 2, 7, 8) · context · 0% immune cells (9th percentile) [F7]; insufficient tumor nuclei flagged · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top-risk regions drops invasive probability more than random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unverified (deletion CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20), and normal lobules (0/20) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Low reliability (45%, 92nd OOD percentile) and model disagreement reflect artifacts masking in situ (3%) or invasive disease.
- Duct-confined score in region 3 (1.36) reflects in situ carcinoma, or normal lobules like contrast case BACH_0038 (76%).

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 8**: Inspect the only nonzero heatmap risk (0.006) and peak invasion (0.37) and pleomorphism (0.59) scores.
2. **Regions 1, 3, 6, 10**: Verify benign tubules (1, 6, 10) and exclude ductal atypia in region 3.
3. **Regions 2, 7, 8**: Check section quality and 20 counted neoplastic nuclei; consider drafted recut or deeper levels.
